name: Supplies for the Crossroads
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
narrative.objectives: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Haha! Thank you, adventurer! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
narrative.requestItemsText: How goes your search for the supplies, adventurer? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 12 to 14, 1,875 XP in all.

quests.name: Disrupt the Attacks
quests.objectiveText: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
